The '''Shuttle Base''' was a small [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] landing platform located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SWG:CS" />

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Shuttle Base appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:CS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Shuttle Base was added to the game along with the [[W:c:swg:Exar Kun|Exar Kun]] heroic encounter,<ref name="SWG:CS" /> released with the "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 9 Notes for April 3 2008|Chapter 9]]" update on [[April 3]], [[2008]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67688&month=042008|text=Chapter 9: The Fury of Exar Kun}}</ref>
